hook: Kaun apne [[boss]] se zyada kama raha hai?

slides.title: Ek hi [[table]] mein boss
slides.note: manager_id = **usi table** ki id. Boss bhi employee hi hai 😄

slides.title: Trick: [[Self JOIN]]
points: Same table ko **do naam** do: e aur m
slides.note: Jaise ek hi class register ki **2 photocopies** rakh ke milana 📄

slides.title: Interview wali [[query]]
slides.code:
SELECT e.name, e.salary,
  m.name AS manager,
  m.salary AS mgr_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN employees m
  ON e.manager_id = m.id
WHERE e.salary > m.salary;

slides.title: Result: [[2 rebels]]
slides.note: Kabir > Aarav, Riya > Meera. Appraisal mein drama pakka 🍿

slides.title: Aliases [[zaroori]] kyun
points: Bina alias: "salary" **kiski**? e ki ya m ki?
Har column ke aage **e. / m.** lagao
slides.note: Same pattern: "employee aur uska manager ka naam" bhi pucha jaata hai

slides.wrong:
LEFT JOIN employees m
  ON e.manager_id = m.id
WHERE e.salary > m.salary
slides.right:
JOIN employees m
  ON e.manager_id = m.id
WHERE e.salary > m.salary
slides.why: Aarav ka m.salary **NULL** → compare **UNKNOWN** → row gayab. LEFT JOIN se sirf confusion
